pages.text: Known spells appear in a single scrollable column. I can drag them into any of eight radial slots. A spell cannot occupy more than one slot, and slots may remain empty.$(br2)The arrangement belongs to me, not to an individual Staff.

Mage Light may be moved or removed from the radial menu, but it remains known. Selecting a wedge changes the spell cast by left-click.$(br2)Channelled spells continue while the casting input is held and consume their listed pulse cost repeatedly.
